Repo: C:/Projects/DS/DS_MessageProtocol. You are applying SYNTHESIZED REVIEW FIXES to a v2 rewrite of a C# message-serialization library (commit 9705af8). Keep the approved scope — do not refactor beyond these fixes. Report changed files, commands run with exit codes, validation evidence, surprises, and anything left undone.

FIXES (all confirmed by reviewers; apply all):

1. STABILITY — generator hint-name collision. `Source/MessageProtocol.CodeGenerator/MessageCodeGenerator.cs` `GetGeneratedFileName` builds the AddSource hint name from simple type names only (namespace ignored). Two message types with the same name in different namespaces collide → ArgumentException inside the source output callback → ALL generated sources for the compilation are dropped. Fix: make the hint name unique — include the full namespace plus nesting plus generic arity, e.g. build from `INamedTypeSymbol.ToDisplayString()` or namespace+MetadataName, and sanitize characters not allowed in hint names (spaces, ':', etc. — Roslyn allows letters/digits/underscores/dots/hyphens/parens/backticks; replace anything else). Add a regression test to `Test/MessageProtocol.Tests/GeneratorDiagnosticTests.cs`: two `[StandaloneMessage]` partial types named `Same` in namespaces `NsA` and `NsB` in one compilation → generator produces both files, no exception (assert generated text contains both RegisterHasIdMessage calls).

2. BENCHMARKS — `Test/MessageProtocol.Benchmarks/Program.cs`: BenchmarkDotNet cannot run — its default csproj toolchain walks the repo and finds two projects named MessageProtocol.Benchmarks (Test/ and Legacy/Test/) → `System.NotSupportedException: Found more than one matching project file`. Reviewer verified `InProcessEmitToolchain` works. Fix: add a `[Config]` class with `AddJob(...)` or `WithOptions` using `BenchmarkDotNet.Toolchains.InProcess.Emit.InProcessEmitToolchain.Instance` (simplest: a manual config class applied via [Config(typeof(...))] on the benchmark class). Validation: `dotnet run --project Test/MessageProtocol.Benchmarks -c Release` must actually start and produce a BDN summary table (let it run to completion; it may take several minutes — that is expected and fine).

3. PARITY — `Source/Shared/MessageWireFormat.cs`: restore two public constants that Legacy had and the rewrite silently dropped (ADR-0001 promised identical public surface): `public const int NullSizedPayloadLength = -1;` and `public const int DefaultStreamCapacity = 256;` (see `Legacy/Source/Shared/MessageWireFormat.cs`).

4. HYGIENE — delete the four stray `generated-out/` dirs (`find . -name generated-out -not -path './Legacy/*'` → remove), add `generated-out/` to `.gitignore`, add a compile-exclusion guard in root `Directory.Build.props` so a future EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles dump can never be compiled by the default glob (`<Compile Remove="**/generated-out/**" />` in an ItemGroup), and remove the empty `<ItemGroup></ItemGroup>` block in `Source/MessageProtocol.CodeGenerator/MessageProtocol.CodeGenerator.csproj` (around line 29-30).

5. DOCS — the Document vault violates AGENTS.md (missing required notes). Create v2-adapted notes (Korean, same style/frontmatter conventions as `Legacy/Document/`; use today's date 2026-08-31 in `updated`):
   - `Document/00-AI/CONTEXT.md` (entry point: repo layout now Source/Test/Sandbox/Legacy, packages 2.0.0, generator netstandard2.0, sibling projects DS_RPC/DS_Communication, reading order)
   - `Document/00-AI/GLOSSARY.md` (adapt Legacy terms; add note that MessageIgnore/MessageInclude now live in MessageProtocol namespace)
   - `Document/00-AI/CONVENTIONS.md` (copy/adapt Legacy vault conventions)
   - `Document/01-Overview/Home.md` (human entry, links to Scope-ish content → Feature-Spec, Overview, Getting-Started not required)
   - `Document/02-Architecture/Overview.md` (short: 3-layer architecture, Shared link compile, links to Feature-Spec)
   - `Document/03-Reference/Public-API.md` (v2 public surface — reflect restored constants and member-attribute namespace)
   - `Document/03-Reference/Packages.md` (3 packages, 2.0.0, TFMs, analyzer path)
   - Append a `_meta/Changelog.md` entry for these fixes/docs (keep newest-on-top).
   Base content on `Legacy/Document/` equivalents but updated to v2 reality (do not copy stale facts like version 1.0.1 or netstandard2.1 generator).

6. REPACK — after code fixes: `dotnet pack MessageProtocol.sln -c Release -o artifacts/packages` (refreshes stale commit provenance in the nupkgs).

VALIDATION (run and report exit codes):
- `dotnet build MessageProtocol.sln` → 0 errors
- `dotnet test Test/MessageProtocol.Tests/MessageProtocol.Tests.csproj` → all green both net8.0+net9.0 (includes your new regression test)
- `dotnet run --project Sandbox/MessageProtocol.Sandbox` → ALL SCENARIOS PASSED, exit 0
- benchmarks run produces a summary table
- `dotnet pack ...` succeeds, artifacts/packages has three 2.0.0 nupkgs

Constraints: do not touch Legacy/ content; do not change wire format bytes; do not expand scope (no nullable/Dictionary member support, no new APIs beyond restored constants). If you hit LSP file-lock errors on the generator DLL (CSharpLanguageServer holding bin files), kill the CSharpLanguageServer processes and retry the build.
